pairs.why: A has the real kit's softer, less lacquered blue and gold finish, while B is over-glossy and toy-chunky with oversized gold fittings.
B gets close to chunky posts, a thick rope coil and a big life ring, as the real card does, while A is a small, distant scenic pier.
A's dark satin housing and plain grey hardware match the real light better than B's added gold knobs, which look more like a toy.
A's colorful knobs and pads and its purple-capped headphones are closer to the real card, while B's cable and plainer controls drift away from it.
A's smaller, denser leaves and clear spiral tiers are closer to the real topiary than B's large, yellow-green, more textured leaves.
The two are nearly the same; A's angle and proportions sit slightly closer to the real pair, though both put too many dots on the soles.
A fills the frame with the same smooth, glossy vinyl look as the real ball, while B is smaller and sits on more photographic sand.
B's curled-fist view and smooth red finish read slightly closer to the real gloves; the two drawings are very similar.
